_comment: Return-rate + city-bonus reference data. The formula and bonus values are corroborated across the official Albion Online wiki (Resource Return Rate / Local Production Bonus pages) and multiple independent 2026 guides. The city->category mapping is corroborated across the official wiki version notes and community references and has been stable for years. Percentages are the best publicly documented values; the exact decimal Focus adds is not officially published (players have reverse-engineered ~59%), so treat return-rate output as a close estimate, not a guarantee -- always cross-check against the in-game crafting window if a decision is expensive.
formula: totalBonus = baseCityBonus + (citySpecialty if crafting/refining in that item's bonus city) + (focusBonus if using focus) + dailyBonus; returnRate = totalBonus / (1 + totalBonus)

bonusComponents._baseCityBonus_note: Present at ANY public station in a Royal city (not private islands), for any item. Alone this yields ~15.3% return.
bonusComponents._citySpecialtyCrafting_note: Extra bonus for crafting equipment/weapons in that item's bonus city specifically.
bonusComponents._citySpecialtyRefining_note: Extra bonus for refining a raw resource in that resource's bonus city specifically. Larger than the crafting specialty.
bonusComponents._focusBonus_note: Flat additive bonus when spending Crafting Focus on the craft/refine. Premium accounts regenerate 10,000 focus/24h, capped at 30,000 stored.
bonusComponents._dailyBonus_note: Each day, 2 item lines per city get an extra rotating daily production bonus (silver day +10%, gold day +20%). This rotates daily and isn't derivable from static data, so it's exposed as a manual toggle in the calculator rather than auto-applied.

marketFees._note: Setup fee only applies if YOU place a buy/sell order and wait for it to fill. Instantly buying the cheapest sell order or instantly selling into the best buy order (what this calculator assumes) only pays the sales/transaction tax, no setup fee.

_sources: Community guides current as of mid-2026 (albioncodex.com, albionmarket.gg)
